In Hindu mythology, gods and goddesses are referred to as 'rulers' of various celestial bodies and elements. This meaningful name reinforces values such as courage, leadership, and self-confidence, all of which are highly valued in Hindu culture.

It represents the deep spiritual belief that one's inner self, or true nature, is not bound by physical limitations, but has the power to rule and influence the universe. It serves as a constant reminder of one's potential for greatness and encourages individuals to live in harmony with the inner and outer worlds, embodying the highest virtues and ideals of the Hindu spiritual tradition.
